LanguageData.ArtificialMaidFabricated: Artificial Maid {0} has been successfully fabricated.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidFabricationFailed: Artificial Maid fabrication failed because the completed unit could not be placed safely.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaid_NotEnoughPower: Insufficient stored electrical energy. Requires {0} Wd of stored power in the connected power net.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaid_DeathLetter_Text: Artificial Maid {0}'s core logic system has crashed. It will attempt to enter auto-repair sequence.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaid_ResurrectionLetter_Text: Artificial Maid {0} has completed self-repair and rebooted its system.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaid_ResurrectionFailedLetter_: Artificial Maid {0}'s recovery system failed to resurrect it.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaid_RepairMessage: Artificial Maid {0} is performing body repair procedures.
LanguageData.ModifyArtificialMaidDesc: Modify the backstory and traits of an Artificial Maid on this map, and perform auto-fix.
LanguageData.NoArtificialMaidFound: No Artificial Maid found on map
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidTraitsCleared: Cleared all Artificial Maid traits from {0}.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidRecruitedText: An Artificial Maid {0} from another faction was found on the map. Due to internal security protocols, she has automatically switched to your faction and performed a full body repair.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidEscortLetterText:
A guard escort from {0} has arrived.
As arranged, or perhaps by coincidence, they have brought an ownerless Artificial Maid. The moment the maid stepped onto this land, her underlying protocol automatically identified your colony as the highest priority. She is now under your command.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidBackupCloudDesc: Restore an Artificial Maid from the latest cloud backup if the original unit is dead or missing.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidBackupCloudRestoredText: Artificial Maid {0} has been restored from the backup cloud.
LanguageData.AutoHibernateDesc: If enabled, idle artificial maids will automatically seek this display case for hibernation.
LanguageData.AutoWakeDesc: If enabled, the occupant will automatically wake up when work is detected on the map.
LanguageData.AllowAutoHibernateDesc: If enabled, this maid will automatically seek a display case for hibernation when idle.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidDisplayCaseEjectDesc: Manually wake up and eject the Artificial Maid from the display case, and disable her auto-hibernate.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidDisplayCaseAutofixDesc: Fully repair the Artificial Maid currently in this display case and replenish her resources.
LanguageData.ImmediateHibernateDesc: Force this maid to stop working and immediately enter the nearest empty display case, and disable auto-wake for that case.
LanguageData.ImmediateWakeDesc: Wake this Artificial Maid from the display case immediately and disable her auto-hibernate.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidPacked: Artificial Maid {0} has been packed into transport box.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidCaravanWorldPathingLimit: Artificial Maid world movement speed: {0} tiles/day
LanguageData.EnableHealingProtocolDesc: If enabled, this artificial maid will continuously provide disease treatment for master.
LanguageData.EnableHuntModeDesc: If enabled, this artificial maid will automatically teleport to and melee attack all hostile units on the map until no enemies remain or the mode is manually disabled. The mode will automatically disable if no targets are found for a while.
LanguageData.HuntModeAutoDisabled: Artificial Maid {0} has automatically disabled Hunt Mode (no targets found).
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidBackupCloudBackupSucceeded: Artificial Maid {0} was backed up successfully.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidBackupCloudNoRegistry: No Artificial Maid identity record exists.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidBackupCloudServiceUnavaila: The backup cloud service is unavailable.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidBackupCloudInvalidMaid: The target is not a valid Artificial Maid.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidBackupCloudSerialConflict: Multiple maids share this serial number. Automatic recovery is disabled.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidBackupCloudBackupState_Sta: Previous backup valid; latest attempt failed
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidBackupCloudLocation_Unroot: Not connected to the game object tree
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidAuraGizmoDesc: Open the global list to grant or remove the "Maid's Presence" aura to any of your pawns. The aura greatly enhances all abilities and stats.
LanguageData.ArtificialMaidAuraDialogHint: Check to grant the aura; uncheck to remove it. The aura automatically disappears when the pawn leaves your faction or you cancel it manually. If it is lost for some reason, it will be re-applied automatically while a maid is nearby.
LanguageData.EnableNonLethalModeDesc: If enabled, this artificial maid's attacks no longer deal damage. Instead, targets are forcibly subdued: knocked down, with all capacities and skills suppressed, while temporary protections keep them alive.
LanguageData.ReleaseSubduedDesc: Select a subdued target to immediately release it, restoring all capacities and skills.
LanguageData.EnableHighDimDesc: When enabled, this artificial maid shifts out of normal spacetime into a higher dimension: she can move and linger through any terrain or structure, never triggers traps, and cannot be attacked by anyone by any means, while still being able to attack enemies herself. Click again to exit.
